annotation.title_clean: 深圳经济特区人工智能产业促进条例
annotation.title_en: Regulations on Promoting the Artificial Intelligence Industry in the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 深圳市人民代表大会常务委员会 (Standing Committee of the Shenzhen Municipal People's Congress)
annotation.venue: 深圳市政府公报 2022年第34期
named_instruments_referenced: 中华人民共和国民法典
annotation.summary_en: Shenzhen's local regulation promoting the AI industry, effective 1 November 2022. It covers R&D support, infrastructure, application scenarios, incentives, and governance: an AI ethics committee, tiered risk-based supervision, algorithm explanation, and prohibited conduct. It has no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Takes effect 1 November 2022; adopted by Shenzhen People's Congress Standing Committee on 30 August 2022.
Establishes a municipal AI Ethics Committee to set and supervise ethics and safety norms.
Tiered supervision: high-risk AI needs prior assessment and risk warning; medium/low-risk needs prior disclosure and follow-up.
Allows pilot testing of low-risk AI products where no standards exist, and inclusive, prudent supervision.
Bans AI uses that endanger security, infringe privacy, discriminate, or enable price discrimination; requires algorithm explanation for public-interest uses.
